title: UK garage
description: The London 2-step sound: a kick that skips, hats that shuffle hard, an organ bass in the gaps and a chopped piano.
author: Strudel Workshop

tracks.title: 2-step basics
tracks.blurb: The skipping kick, hard swing, an organ bass in the gaps and a chopped piano.

lessons.title: The 2-step kick
lessons.goal: Break the four-on-the-floor: a kick on 1 and the "and" of 2, snare on 2 and 4.
lessons.concept:
UK garage grew out of the London pirate-radio scene in the mid-90s, speeding up American garage house and, in **2-step**, throwing away the steady kick. Producers like Todd Edwards and MJ Cole made the drums skip instead of stomp.

The 2-step kick hits on **beat 1** and the **"and" of 2**: `"bd [~ bd] ~ ~"`. The snare keeps the backbeat on 2 and 4, so the groove still turns over every bar even though the kick is missing half its steps.

That gap is the whole style: with no kick on 3, the bass and the vocal have room to move.

tasks.text: Make the kick play on beat 1 and the "and" of 2 only.
Add a part called snare on beats 2 and 4.
tasks.hint: const snare = s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.8), then stack(kick, snare)

challenge.text: Add a second kick on the last 16th of beat 4, so the bar pushes into the next.

summary: 2-step drops the kick from beats 2, 3 and 4: it hits on 1 and the "and" of 2.
The snare keeps 2 and 4 so the bar still turns over.
The gap on beat 3 is where the bass lives.

lessons.title: Skipping hats
lessons.goal: Shuffle 16th hats hard enough to skip, with accents on the beat.
lessons.concept:
Garage swings much harder than house. On an MPC you would push swing to 60% or more; here `.swingBy(.2, 8)` delays every second 16th by a fifth of a step and the hats start to **skip**.

A gain pattern puts the weight on the beat and keeps the in-between hats light, so the shuffle reads as bounce rather than mess. An open hat on the "and" of 2 and 4 is the classic garage answer to the snare.

tasks.text: Make the hats 16ths with the hit on each beat louder than the next one.

challenge.text: Add an open hat on the "and" of 2 and the "and" of 4, quiet.

summary: Garage swing is heavy: .swingBy(.2, 8) is about 60%.
A gain pattern keeps the weight on the beat.
An open hat on the "and" of 2 and 4 answers the snare.

lessons.title: The organ bass in 8ths
lessons.goal: Write a short, hollow bass on the offbeat 8ths, in a key.
lessons.concept:
Where house puts the bass on the offbeats of a steady kick, 2-step lets it **bounce in the gaps**: short organ-like stabs on every offbeat 8th, over a kick that only hits twice a bar. The square wave through a low-pass is the cheap-organ tone of a thousand white labels.

Keep it in a key so it agrees with the piano later: `n("…").scale("C2:minor")` picks degrees of C minor two octaves down. Short decay, no sustain, and it stays out of the snare’s way.

tasks.text: Add a part called bass: a square wave on every offbeat 8th, scale degrees of C minor in octave 2.
tasks.hint: const bass = n("[~ 0] [~ 0] [~ 3] [~ 5]").scale("C2:minor").s("square"), and stack it

tasks.text: Make every note a short stab: quick decay, no sustain.
Round it off with a low-pass around 800 Hz.

challenge.text: Add a sine sub an octave below on the same degrees.

summary: The 2-step bass bounces in the gaps the kick leaves: offbeat 8ths.
scale("C2:minor") picks degrees two octaves down.
Short decay, no sustain, low-pass: a cheap organ.

lessons.title: Chopped piano
lessons.goal: Strike a piano chord in a syncopated pattern, cut short.
lessons.concept:
Garage producers chopped vocals and pianos into stabs and re-played them against the beat. Without vocals we chop the **piano**: one chord, struck wherever the pattern says, each hit cut short with `.clip`.

`chord("<Cm7 Fm7>").voicing()` picks the notes; `.struct("…")` is the rhythm, one `x` per hit; `.clip(.4)` shortens every note to 40% of its step, so the chord stabs instead of ringing. Keep the pattern **syncopated**: hits off the beat more often than on it.

tasks.text: Add a part called piano: a Cm7 chord struck in a syncopated 16th pattern.
tasks.hint: const piano = chord("Cm7").voicing().struct("[~ x ~ ~] [~ ~ x ~] [~ x ~ ~] [x ~ ~ x]").s("piano").gain(.6), and stack it

tasks.text: Cut every hit short with clip.

challenge.text: Change the chord every bar: Cm7, then Fm7.

summary: .struct("…") gives a chord a rhythm; one x per hit.
.clip(.4) cuts each note to 40% of its step: a stab, not a ring.
Syncopate: more hits off the beat than on it.

lessons.title: The skip
lessons.goal: Add ghost rims and a second snare between the main hits.
lessons.concept:
What makes 2-step drums **skip** is everything that happens between the kick and the snare: quiet rimshots a 16th before the beat, a second, softer snare on an offbeat, hits you feel more than hear.

They go in their own part, kept at a low gain, so the main snare stays in charge. `sd:1` picks the second snare sample, a touch different from the backbeat one.

tasks.text: Add a part called skip: rimshots on the last 16th of beats 1 and 3, and the third 16th of beat 2, quiet.
tasks.hint: const skip = s("[~ ~ ~ rim] [~ ~ rim ~] [~ ~ ~ rim] ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3), and stack it

tasks.text: Add a ghost snare in the skip part: the second 16th of beat 4, using sd:1.

challenge.text: Add a second ghost snare on the second 16th of beat 2, just as quiet.

summary: Ghost hits between the main ones make the drums skip.
Keep them in their own part at a low gain.
sd:1 is a second snare sample.

lessons.title: Project: A 2-step tune
lessons.goal: Put the kick, the skip, the organ bass and the chopped piano together, in one key.
lessons.concept:
A 2-step tune from this pack’s parts: skipping drums, a bass in the gaps, a chopped piano answering it. One `const key` keeps the bass and the piano in tune, so a new key is one edit.

Keep the levels garage-like: the snare the loudest thing, the piano behind the drums, the bass felt in the gap on beat 3. Then a fill every four bars so the loop breathes.

tasks.text: Add hard-swung 16th hats with a gain pattern, and stack them.
Add the organ bass on the offbeat 8ths, in the key, short and filtered.
Add the chopped piano, two chords alternating, clipped short, behind the drums.
tasks.hint: const piano = chord("<Cm7 Fm7>").voicing().struct("[~ x ~ ~] [~ ~ x ~] [~ x ~ ~] [x ~ ~ x]").s("piano").clip(.4).gain(.6)

challenge.text: Roll the snare on the last bar of every four.
challenge.hint: Add .lastOf(4, x => x.ply(2)) to the snare line

summary: A 2-step tune: skipping drums, bass in the gaps, a chopped piano.
One const key keeps bass and piano in tune.
A fill every four bars (.lastOf) marks the phrase.
